title: Examiner defined.
bodyText: For purposes of this part, "examiner" means any individual or firm authorized by the commissioner to conduct an examination under the insurance code.
bodyHtml: [§431:2-301.5]  Examiner defined.  For purposes of this part, "examiner" means any individual or firm authorized by the commissioner to conduct an examination under the insurance code. [L 1993, c 321, pt of §2]
